component.name: archmaid
component.summary: Keep an Arch Linux system clean and up to date

description.p: archmaid runs routine Arch Linux housekeeping from one window: it cleans the package cache, removes orphaned packages, trims the journal and old temporary files, and updates the system.
Privileged steps run a fixed root helper through polkit, authorized with your own password. A run shows its plan before it starts and keeps a log.
